messages:
Maria Chen: quick heads-up — running a runway sim for the 30B TGI bring-up across us-east1 and europe-west1. goal: find minimal reserved GPUs to hit 95th p99 latency target while keeping cost delta < 20%.

Ajay Patel: SGTM. what q/configs are we testing? H100 A100 mix? q4f16 vs q8_0?

Maria Chen: starting with H100-only, q4f16 and q8_0. also testing fallback to 13B quant variant for cold tails. concurrency targets: 8/slot for 30B at p50 baseline but need to validate p99.

Sofia Gomez: throwing in a kernel split config — enable fused-attn for H100 and generic kernel for A100 to see latency tail.

Liam O'Neill: can you paste the sim command? want to run a variant with heavier short-seq traffic.

Maria Chen: here —
```bash
./capacity-sim --model tgi-30b --region us-east1,europe-west1 \
  --gpu-types H100,A100 --kernel-split H100:fused,A100:generic \
  --quant q4f16,q8_0 --concurrency 4,8,12 --target-p99 0.9 \
  --burst-margin 1.25 --fallback-model tgi-13b-quant --samples 100000
```

Ajay Patel: nice. initial run (us-east1/H100/q4f16) numbers: p50=78ms, p95=120ms, p99=240ms at concurrency=8. throughput per GPU ~110 tok/s.

Sofia Gomez: europe-west1 shows +14% p99 vs us-east1 on the same config (network jitter + kernel warmup). need extra headroom in eu.

Maria Chen: noted. with fallback enabled (13B for cold prefix) p99 improves to 160ms but throughput drops ~18%. tradeoff: cost down vs tail up.

Liam O'Neill: ops-bot, what's current Dedicated pool spare capacity in eu region?

ops-bot: eu-dedicated-pool: spare_gpus=18, avg_util=68% :information_source: 

Ajay Patel: math quick take: to hit p99 SLO across both regions with 25% autoscale headroom, we need ~42 H100 GPUs (us-east baseline) + 18 backup burst A100s in eu to account for network tail.

Maria Chen: that sounds high. can we reduce by aggressive kernel config + prefix cache? try: cache enabled, batch cap 64, sequencer tuning.

Sofia Gomez: re-run queued with cache on and warmup windows. also add metric: rollback-safety if p99 > 300ms for 5m.

Maria Chen: FYI deploy-bot will run the canary after sims finish. planning a canary window 30m with 5% traffic on Dedicated eu pool, auto-fallback to hosted API if p99 breach.

deploy-bot: canary scheduled: 2003338000, traffic=5%, rollback_policy=auto-fallback, alert_channel=#oncall-eng

Liam O'Neill: action items: 1) Ajay re-run sim with cache+kernel tweaks and include cost model, 2) Sofia add eu-tail jitter in sim, 3) Maria coordinate canary doc + rollback steps.

Maria Chen: thanks — I'll post the sim artifacts and a short runbook in #eng-platform once sims complete. :thumbsup:

Ajay Patel: starting re-runs now, will attach CSVs.

Sofia Gomez: noted, will add a small load test that spikes 2x for 3m to validate autoscale reaction.

Maria Chen: perfect. closing thread for now, will update with numbers.
